strategy: Spam Command Fallen to generate Wrath, then use Bombardment as your primary damage dealer while Ae'grom and summoned Lesser Demons handle additional combat. Killing monsters or your own demons fuels Sigil summons, creating a self-reinforcing 'automated damage' cycle that scales through leveling.

paragon.note: Vanguard swaps for Attrition in the boss-fight variant. Prioritize survivability over damage early; hit minimum glyph requirements instead of maxing them out. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
